name: 01830 · Haverhill, MA
findings: ZIP 01830 (Haverhill) has 106 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (47% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01830 (Haverhill) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
